The whole family smiled, seeing how kindness, respect, and affection turn ordinary moments into lasting memories.

adult.reflection_en: Within Book of Love & Affection (Pre-marital Love — Chapter 110: 'Recognition of the Signs'), Kural 1096 distills a foundational ethical insight: "Though with their lips affection they disown, Yet, when they hate us not, 'tis quickly known" Philosophically, Though they may speak harshly as if they were strangers, the words of the friendly are soon understood.

child.kutty_story_en: On a sunny weekend, Tamizhini's grandparents visited home, filling the house with warmth and laughter. Grandma shared a gentle story inspired by Kural 1097 from 'Recognition of the Signs', highlighting how caring hearts and kind words strengthen family harmony. She explained that noticing how loved ones feel and responding with patience keeps every home cheerful and safe. Inspired by the story, Tamizhini helped prepare tea and shared favorite books with younger cousins. The whole family smiled, seeing how kindness, respect, and affection turn ordinary moments into lasting memories.
child.moral_ta: நீதி: பகையுணர்வு இல்லாத கடுமொழியும், பகைவரை நோக்குவது போன்ற கடுவிழியும், வெளியில் அயலார் போல நடித்துக்கொண்டு உள்ளத்தால் அன்பு கொண்டிருப்பவரை அடையாளம் காட்டும் குறிப்புகளாகும்.
child.moral_en: Moral: The slighting words that anger feign, while eyes their love revealAre signs of those that love, but would their love conceal.
